description:
Tired of circling around looking for parking in your city? Welcome to Carfy!

Carfy is the collaborative app designed by and for drivers who want to stop wasting time and money on expensive parking. Thanks to our community, finding parking anywhere in the world has never been easier.

What can you do with Carfy?

Find parking anywhere in the world: Explore our interactive map and discover open spaces, street parking, and low-cost parking.

Smart color coding:

- Green: 100% Free!

- Yellow: Low-cost or special-rate parking.

- Purple: Parking areas not yet confirmed by any user.

Active Community: Found a new spot in your neighborhood? Add it! Is a parking lot no longer free? Report it! There's strength in numbers and it keeps the map up-to-date.

Verified information: Check real-time confirmations and reports from other users to see if a spot is reliable before you arrive. Don't be surprised.

Karma System: Become a "Road Ninja"! Earn points for every collaboration, rank up, and help the driver community grow.

Your favorites at your fingertips: Save those strategic spots where there's always space and access them with a single click, wherever you are.

Why choose Carfy?

- 100% Collaborative: We're not a parking company; we're a network of drivers helping other drivers.

- Mapbox Technology: High-precision, fast, and smooth maps so you don't waste a second.

- Direct Navigation: Choose your parking spot, and we'll open the route in Google Maps, Waze, or Apple Maps with just one tap.

Say goodbye to the stress of parking and exorbitant fees. Download Carfy today and join the smartest network of drivers.

Free parking is possible when we do it together!

description:
A modern car launcher with fully offline turn-by-turn navigation. Download your region once, navigate anywhere — no internet, no subscriptions, no tracking.

Built for drivers who want a clean, fast dashboard that works without relying on cloud services.

OFFLINE NAVIGATION

Download offline maps for your country and get turn-by-turn directions powered by the same routing engine used by major navigation apps. Automatic rerouting, voice instructions, speed limits, and manoeuvre icons — all running locally on your device.

• Search for places, streets, and points of interest — entirely offline

• Up to 3 alternative routes with distance and duration

• Automatic rerouting when you leave the route

• Voice-guided turn-by-turn instructions

• Speed limit signs and road name display

• Works without internet after initial map download

CAR DASHBOARD

Replace your home screen with a purpose-built driving interface. Split view shows media and weather alongside the map, or expand to full map mode.

• Media controls with album art, track info, and playback progress

• Live weather with hourly forecast

• GPS speedometer with configurable units

• Trip recording with distance and speed history

• Favourite destinations for one-tap navigation

• Status bar with speed, location, and media info

CUSTOMIZATION

Make it yours with accent colors, custom wallpapers, and flexible layouts.

• 8 accent color presets or pick any custom color

• Dark and light map styles

• Adjustable panel ratio (split view)

• Left-hand and right-hand drive layouts

• Custom background images with overlay control

• Icon pack support

• Configurable grid size and pinned app count

PRIVACY FIRST

No accounts. No analytics. No advertising. No data collection. Your location never leaves your device except for weather updates. Search, navigation, and routing all happen locally.

ONE-TIME PURCHASE

Pay once, use forever. No monthly fees, no subscriptions, no in-app ads. Map updates are free.

SUPPORTED REGIONS

47 regions available including US, UK, Germany, France, India, Brazil, Australia, Japan, and more. New regions added regularly based on user requests.

PERFECT FOR

• Android head units and car stereos

• Tablets mounted on the dashboard

• Phones used as car displays

• Areas with poor or no mobile signal

• Drivers who value privacy

Maps built from OpenStreetMap data. Routing powered by Valhalla.

This app is your companion for life with an electric car, turning public charging from a chore into something you barely think about. Whether you're topping up around the corner or charging mid-journey, the whole public network sits in one app.

description:
Your car already knows more about your driving than you do. Aximote unlocks it!

Aximote is a car data and driving app that turns your vehicle's data into clear, actionable insights. It works as a trip tracker, mileage tracker, and fuel and charging cost log — all in one place, with no extra OBD hardware required for supported vehicles.

Track every trip automatically, monitor mileage and fuel consumption, and see exactly how charging costs, gas mileage, and driving style affect your total cost of ownership. Aximote is built for drivers who want more than a basic mileage log — it's a full driving insights platform that helps you understand your car the way a fitness tracker helps you understand your body.

BUILT FOR MODERN CONNECTED VEHICLES

Aximote works without additional OBD hardware. The Aximote experience combines an In-Car App for real-time driving feedback with a Mobile App for detailed trip history, cost analysis, driving insights, and trip-by-trip comparisons.

WORKS ACROSS EV, HYBRID, AND COMBUSTION VEHICLES

Whether you drive an electric vehicle, plug-in hybrid, hybrid, or combustion car, Aximote helps you understand what's really happening on the road — mileage, fuel use, energy consumption, and driving behavior, all in one driving log. Aximote is especially relevant for drivers of selected models from Volvo, Polestar, Renault, Chevrolet, Cadillac, GMC, Honda, Acura, Nissan, Ford, Lincoln, and other supported brands. Availability may vary by model, region, and vehicle data access.

WHO AXIMOTE IS FOR

Aximote is built for drivers who want to understand their car the same way fitness trackers help people understand their body. Instead of leaving vehicle data hidden in the background, Aximote makes trips, costs, consumption, and driving behavior easier to review and compare.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH AXIMOTE:

- Track trips and review your full driving history

- Log mileage automatically — no manual mileage tracker needed

- Understand car costs across charging, fuel, and everyday driving

- Analyze fuel consumption, energy consumption, gas mileage (MPG), and efficiency

description:
Voxtri is a voice assistant for drivers who make several stops a day — to meet clients, deliver, or run errands. Enter today's stops once and Voxtri takes it from there: one route through your whole day, every address and contact in one place, and a ready-made text for the next client when you're running late. No jumping between maps, calendar and messengers, no copying addresses or searching for phone numbers on the road. Your day stays under control — and your clients always know when to expect you.

WHY DRIVERS USE VOXTRI

- Set up once: add stops or pull them from your calendar — no copy-pasting between apps.

- Everything for the day in one place: stops, arrival times, client contacts.

- Clients hear from you before they start waiting — fewer "where are you?" calls.

- Fewer apps, fewer taps, a calmer day.

DAY PLAN

- Add up to 12 stops for today, each with the time you need to be there.

- Connect your phone calendar and today's events with a time and a place become stops automatically. Voxtri only reads your calendar and never changes it.

- Preview one multi-stop route through all remaining stops: total driving time, distance and the expected arrival at each stop.

- Tap Go for turn-by-turn navigation through every stop at once. Change the plan on the way and the route continues from where you are.

- Running late? Voxtri notices and offers to text the person waiting at the next stop. It opens your messaging app with a ready-made text — you check it and press Send yourself. Voxtri never sends messages on its own.

- At the end of the day, see how many stops you made on time and how many clients you warned in advance.

YOUR AI CO-PILOT: VOICE ASSISTANT FOR DRIVERS

Tap to talk and ask by voice:

- find a place and navigate to it, with saved places like Home and Work;

- play music in your music app;

- check your calendar;

- dictate a message — Voxtri drafts it and you choose where to send it;

- set reminders by time, place or route ("remind me to call John when I arrive at work");

- search the internet or just chat.

Voxtri remembers the personal facts you share and forgets them when you ask.

VOXTRI PREMIUM

Planning, editing and previewing your day are free, and your first day plan route is free too. After that, starting a day plan route and regular navigation require a Voxtri Premium subscription. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; you can manage or cancel them in Google Play at any time.

DRIVE SAFELY

Keep your eyes on the road and follow local traffic laws. While you drive, Voxtri offers a late text only when the road situation is calm.

description:
You hear the problem before it becomes one.

TPMS Connect speaks your tyre warnings out loud, through your phone or straight through your car stereo. No windscreen monitor to mount. No dash light to notice. No glancing down at a screen while you are towing at highway speed.

A tyre starts losing pressure and you hear it, in plain words, over the top of whatever you are listening to.

Built in Australia for towing, touring and work vehicles.

Voice alerts that reach you

• Spoken warnings through your car stereo over Bluetooth

• Also plays through your phone speaker if you are not connected

• Tells you which tyre and what is wrong, so you know before you pull over

• Cuts through music, podcasts and navigation

• Works with your hands on the wheel and your eyes on the road

Full monitoring behind it

• Live pressure and temperature for every tyre

• Alerts when a tyre drops below or climbs above your limits

• High temperature warnings, an early sign of a failing tyre or dragging brake

• Set your own pressure thresholds per vehicle

• Cars, utes, 4WDs, caravans, camper trailers, motorhomes, boat trailers and work vehicles

• Multi axle setups, including vehicle plus trailer combinations

• Works over Bluetooth with no mobile reception needed

Why it matters when you are towing

A slow leak on a caravan tyre is easy to miss. Heat builds, the tyre lets go at speed, and you are on the shoulder of the highway with damage that costs far more than a set of tyres. A monitor you have to look at only helps if you look at it. A voice alert reaches you whether you are watching or not.

You will need SAVR sensors

This app works with SAVR tyre pressure sensors, sold separately at savr.me. Packs are available for single vehicles right through to vehicle and multiple trailer setups.

About permissions

Android requires location permission for any app that scans for Bluetooth devices. TPMS Connect uses it only to find your sensors. We never record, store or share your location.

Important safety note

TPMS Connect is a monitoring aid, not a replacement for checking your tyres. Voice alerts depend on Bluetooth range, sensor battery, phone battery, and your volume and notification settings. Always carry out normal pre-trip checks.

Support

Email support@savr.me and you will hear back from a real person.

description:
MEASURE YOUR CAR'S ACCELERATION — WITHOUT EXPENSIVE GPS TRACKERS!

With STAR, anyone can measure how quickly their car accelerates. Run a 0-60 acceleration test, time your drag race over a set distance such as the quarter mile, or track your top speed — all using nothing but your phone.

Configure your runs safely at a standstill, and with rolling starts the app automatically detects the moment you pull away and begins measuring for you. You can even run multiple measurements at the same time.

Every result is stored locally on your phone so you can revisit it later — no data is ever transmitted to us. Each run comes with analysis tools like graphs, top and average speed, a map of the route you drove, and more.

—— FEATURES AT A GLANCE ——

• YOUR GARAGE: Add every car you drive — complete with a photo and details like make, model, year, drivetrain, power, and weight. STAR tracks each car's runs and records separately.

• STATS & PERSONAL BESTS: See each car's best 0–60, top speed, quarter mile, averages, and run counts at a glance — and watch how every new run stacks up against your personal best.

• UNLIMITED MEASUREMENTS: Want to time the quarter mile and 0–60 in the same run? No problem — configure as many measurements as you like at once, and STAR handles the rest.

• DIFFERENT MEASUREMENT MODES: Speed-based or drag race (distance) — choose the modes that fit the run you want to make.

• ROLLING STARTS: Set everything up safely while stationary and let the app do the work — your measurement begins automatically the instant you start driving.

• IN-DEPTH ANALYSIS: Every run is saved locally and can be explored afterwards with a speed graph, top and average speed, route details, and more.

• ROUTE MAP: The route you drove is saved with each run, so you can revisit it later on a map.

• HISTORY, ORGANIZED: Browse all your runs in the archive and filter by car to find exactly what you're looking for. Delete any run you no longer need.

• LIVE SPEED & GPS INFO: A live GPS speedometer keeps your current and top speed in view throughout every run, and the live satellite count confirms a strong signal before you launch.

• DARK MODE: Driving at night? STAR follows your phone's appearance settings and includes a dark mode with true blacks — easy on your eyes and your battery.

• PRIVATE BY DESIGN: All of your data stays on your device. Nothing is sent to us.

Have an idea for a new feature or a suggestion to make STAR even better? Write to us at hi@sunnyside.dev — we'd love to hear from you!

description:
Struggling with a blindingly bright screen during night driving?

Many Android devices and aftermarket Chinese Android Head Units (AHUs) have a high minimum hardware brightness level that remains too bright for dark cabin environments. DashDim solves this by creating a highly-customizable, system-level software overlay that dims your display beyond normal system limits. Works on all devices but it has extra features for Car Headunits

Drive safer and reduce eye strain with fully automated, context-aware dimming!

✨ CORE FEATURES:

• Context-Aware Dimming Modes:

1. Headlight Sync (For Car Head Units): Instantly dims the screen when you turn on your headlights, listening directly to your car MCU's backlight broadcast signals.

2. Smart GPS Sunset/Sunrise Auto-Dim: Uses an offline, math-based astronomical algorithm to calculate your local sunset and sunrise times. Dimming starts automatically at dusk and ends at dawn.

3. Manual Time Scheduling: Set a custom window (e.g., 20:00 to 07:00) with interactive pickers to schedule screen dimming. Supports crossing midnight.

4. Constant Manual Overlay: Disable automatic triggers and use DashDim as a constant manual screen filter set to your exact opacity preference.

• Physical Backlight Dimming (Optional Root required):

Directly dims the physical LED backlight of the screen by writing to kernel sysfs nodes. True hardware dimming reduces actual screen power consumption and provides a perfect dark cabin environment without glowing black software pixels. Features a built-in 3% safety floor to prevent completely blacked-out screens.

• Reverse Camera Safety Bypass:

Safety comes first. DashDim monitors when your vehicle is shifted into reverse and instantly removes the dimming overlay, ensuring your backup camera is 100% bright and visible. The overlay reappears once you shift out of reverse.

• Customizable Overlay Tints:

- Black: Traditional linear glare reduction.

- Amber: Warm brown-orange filter to block harsh blue light spectrums and ease night driving strain.

- Navy: Rich dark-blue tint that preserves background contrast and prevents gray washing on LCD panels.

• Touch-Through Window Technology:

The overlay is fully non-interactive and "touch-through," meaning you can interact with all underlying apps (Google Maps, Waze, YouTube, Spotify) without any touch delays or blocking.

• Advanced Full-Screen Layouts:

Force the overlay to stretch across physical screen dimensions, ignoring system safe margins, covering camera notches, status bars, and navigation bars on compatible setups.

• Ultra Battery-Efficient:

Designed with automotive battery safety in mind. The GPS auto-dim mode queries coordinates only once when activated and uses lightweight timers to check the clock, ensuring zero background GPS or CPU drain while driving.

• 100% Private & Offline:

No account required. DashDim does not access the internet, send telemetries, or track your data. All sunset math and triggers are calculated locally on your device.

ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE API USAGE DISCLOSURE

DashDim features an optional screen-dimming overlay capability ("Dim System Bars Safely") which requires the use of Android's AccessibilityService API.

Why we use it:

Android restricts standard applications from drawing overlays over system-controlled screen elements. We use the AccessibilityService API solely to display a translucent dark overlay layer over the system status bar and navigation bar, allowing you to dim the entire screen uniformally at night.

What we do NOT do:

• We do not collect, monitor, read, store, or share any screen content, personal data, user credentials, or keystrokes.

• The accessibility service operates 100% locally and offline on your device, with zero internet permissions.

• It does not alter your system settings or interfere with your interface controls in any other way.

You can freely enable or disable this feature at any time from within the application settings.

description:
All information about used cars!

Infobot: checking a car by VIN and state number helps reduce risks when buying and allows you to check the car number in the current databases (Traffic Police, FSSP, NIS, ownership history).

Checking a car by VIN code

Searching by VIN code provides the most complete data on a used car and its history. The application will tell you where to find the VIN code. Both manual entry and data scanning using your smartphone camera are available. Just point the camera at the VIN code in the document or on the car.

Checking a car by state number

Find out complete information on a used car and its history in accordance with the traffic police and police databases. Also available is information on MTPL insurance policies, court and bailiff data, insurance costs and taxes for cars registered in the Russian Federation.

If you do not have access to the car or its documents to find out its VIN code, here you can check the car number and find the VIN code associated with this number.

Full information about the vehicle from open and closed databases

Use the infobot for free or subscribe to the extended version. Free car check by VIN code or registration number allows you to get data from open data of the FSSP, as well as closed databases, such as the traffic police database or the MTPL database.

So, Autoteka Infobot will help you get the following information:

  • brief information about the car
  • information about the vehicle registration document
  • information about the state registration plate (by whom and when it was issued)
  • history of registration actions
  • information about accidents (except for accidents registered under the Europrotocol)
  • information about the owner's search or the car being stolen
  • information about the technical inspection (time and place, mileage by dates) or disposal (checking the car by VIN code)
  • data about court decisions on the vehicle
  • data about the owners

Fines and restrictions

Here you can quickly check the car number and find out about everything that can interfere with the registration of the vehicle in your name:

  • check the legal purity of the car and the possibility of registration actions with it
  • find out about current and paid fines, as well as about the debts of the car owner

Information about the technical condition of the car and its maintenance

With the help of our service, you can check the car number or its VIN code and find out the terms of car maintenance by previous owners, as well as:

  • equipment
  • age and average mileage according to Rosstat data
  • maintenance history (according to some service stations)
  • OSAGO cost
  • transport tax amount

Anti-reseller assistant

Infobot will help you check the car number and track its history on the websites avito.ru, auto.ru and others. Enter the state registration number and find photos of the car that appeared in ads for sale over several years.

Conditions of vehicle operation and acquisition

  • purpose of use (taxi, car sharing)
  • methods of acquisition by the current owner (leasing / credit, credit and collateral obligations)
  • for foreign cars - customs clearance features (problems)

Important: The application uses data from the databases of the State Traffic Safety Inspectorate of the Russian Federation, the Federal Bailiff Service of the Russian Federation and other sources, but is NOT a government service and is NOT associated with government agencies. Sources of information:

  • Official website of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation https://mvd.ru
  • Official website of the Federal Bailiff Service of the Russian Federation https://fssp.gov.ru/iss/ip
  • Official website of the National Insurance Institute of the Russian Federation https://nsis.ru/products/osago/check/

The databases are available only for cars registered in the territory of the Russian Federation.

Install Infobot and you will be able to check the car number yourself. Car check by VIN code is also available. Detailed information and history of the car. Information about the vehicle (closed traffic police database). Data on OSAGO, taxes, debts.

description:
Rally del Ciocco, 2014. I'm competing.

I arrive from a downhill stretch at around 150/160 km/h. My co-pilot, Anna, reads: “300 meters of reach: attention right three dangerous for left hairpin”. I get to fifth gear quickly, brake hard because the co-pilot is there to remind me. I do the right three well in third gear, I apply the handbrake in the left hairpin in a “rally sweep” and I go away safe and precise.

THE REFLECTION:

Every time I pass by, I see that Guard Rail on “right three” which is always marked by accidents of drivers who get caught out by their lack of knowledge of the road, and I say to myself: “Ah, if they had had a co-pilot…”

And here's the idea!

I get support from a team of IT experts and in the development of artificial intelligence algorithms and I use my experience to transfer it to a digital solution, available to everyone!

I, a professional rally driver, use a co-pilot because I want to go fast, but an "automatic co-pilot" can be used in ALL vehicles, for more valid reasons such as: safety, to drive better, to consume less... Because "knowing means face the road better."

CoDrive is born!

-Paolo Andreucci-

The idea behind the CoDrive algorithm was born in the world of rally racing, where the "navigator" (or "co-driver") helps the driver in two phases:

– first (the day before the race) taking notes (we call them “notes”) on all the curves of the track

– then, during the race, using those notes to give precise real-time instructions on how to tackle each stretch.

CoDrive replicates all this in a digital way, acting as an intelligent driving assistant capable of automatically creating these "notes", so as to communicate in advance, as each curve approaches, its category, which identifies its characteristics, including the level of difficulty, thus helping the driver to use the right steering angle, the level of braking and the moment to accelerate, to deal with it in the best possible way.

Codrive incorporates three different patented algorithms developed in collaboration with the Perceptive Robotics laboratory of the Sant'Anna School of Advanced Studies in Pisa, absolutely unique in the sector and already tested on over 500,000 km worldwide by the award-winning Italian rally champion Paolo Andreucci

First Algorithm

The core of CoDrive: the automatic calculation of "notes"

The "core" algorithm, patented in 2021, is able to break down each route and categorize each curve automatically, according to a complex system of characteristics carefully identified thanks to the great experience of the rally champion Paolo Andreucci who, together with a team software expert, he has digitally encoded all his knowledge.

Second Algorithm

Notification of alerts

While driving, the "notes" on the upcoming curves are communicated to the driver with the right anticipation so that he can prepare to face them in the best possible way.

Parameters detected in real time such as driving speed and acceleration are constantly compared with the predicted values ​​(the right range of predicted values) for that particular curve, with an immediate warning sound in case of excessive differences.

Third Algorithm

Driving behavior analysis

Once the journey is finished, the driving style classification algorithm assigns a "score" to the performance just performed, taking into account how well or poorly the various curves were tackled. The "journey replay" option allows the driver to review their journey and the performance of the route they have just taken, giving them the opportunity to see where errors have been made and thus allowing them to understand how to improve their driving style.

* Shared networking and API layer

✓ Compare financing from dealers with the best offers online

✓ Synchronise your searches & listings across all devices

✓ Save time by selling directly to a buying station

✓ Get an offer from verified dealers in your area

Are you looking for a BMW 3 Series, F30 or SportLine? Or perhaps a VW ID.4, with a convenience package and maximum mileage of 10,000 km, within your city? Or do you want a holiday vehicle, like a VW Bus T6 California with automatic transmission, all-wheel drive and pop-up roof? No problem.

mobile.de is Germany's biggest vehicle market, with over 1.4 million cars, including some 80,000 electric cars, plus almost 100,000 motorbikes, scooters and mopeds, more than 100,000 commercial vehicles and buses, and over 65,000 caravans and motorhomes. And as of 2024, also e-bikes.

Your dream vehicle is sure to be among them!

Financing, leasing or buying online?

Want to finance or lease your new car? You can search specifically for leasing offers, filter by monthly rates or use a finance calculator to find the right offer for you.

And that's not all: you can also buy your new car completely online, from the comfort of your sofa, and get it delivered to your doorstep with a 14-day right of return.

Price rating and dealer rating

Our price rating helps you to compare the vehicle price against the market price, while the dealer rating helps you to navigate between the many dealerships. For added practicality, if you've already found one or more trustworthy dealers, you can follow them on the platform. Going to 'My searches' allows you to view any new listings from these dealers quickly and without spam.

The only trouble is, there are so many to choose from!. Fortunately, thanks to smart search criteria and lots of filter options, you'll find exactly the vehicle for you quickly and easily.

Selling

Whether you want to sell an old Astra, a KTM 390 Duke that's almost as good as new, a well-travelled camper van or the semi-trailer truck you inherited from your grandma, you'll find the biggest pool of potential buyers for your used vehicle at mobile.de. And best of all, private listings are free of charge up to a sales price of 30,000 euros. Advertising on mobile.de is worthwhile for commercial sellers, too.

Direct car sales

In a hurry? If you can't spare the time to negotiate with strangers or offer test drives, or if you're not entirely comfortable with the whole sales process, you can sell your car quickly and directly to a certified dealer via a buying station. Simply get a free, no-obligation estimate for the value of your used car from an expert. If you're happy with the price, you can sell your vehicle directly. The buying station will take care of deregistration process and you'll have your money in no time.

description:
Fixiom is a real diagnostic partner: an AI mechanic that reads your codes, watches your live sensor data, and works the problem with you — step by step — until you have an answer you can act on.

Fixiom is an OBD2 scanner, car code reader, and AI diagnostic tool in one app: check engine light codes, live data, freeze frames, battery test, and a mechanic-grade diagnosis conversation that guides your car repair — with a free scan tool at the core.

No subscription required. The scan tool is free forever, credit packs never expire, and there's no account and no sign-up — ever. You'll need a Bluetooth LE OBD2 adapter (about $25–45, sold separately) for the scan-tool features; the AI mechanic works with just your phone.

Built on the shop floor.

THE SCAN TOOL IS FREE — FOREVER

Pair a cheap OBD2 Bluetooth adapter (about $20) and Fixiom becomes a full scan tool, no subscription, no credits:

• Read and clear check engine codes — with plain-English explanations

• Scan every module on newer vehicles (ABS, airbag, transmission and more)

• Live sensor gauges with real charts, freeze frames, and trip fuel economy

• Battery & charging system test

• Emissions readiness for smog checks

All of that is free for good — no trial, no expiration. The AI mechanic is the one part that uses credits — 25 free credits to start. When you want more: one-time credit packs from $4.99 (they never expire) or plans from $11.99/month. No subscription required.

THE AI MECHANIC

Describe the problem the way you'd tell a mechanic — or just connect the adapter. Fixiom's AI:

• Reads your actual codes and live data, not just generic definitions

• Asks the right follow-up questions, one at a time

• Watches sensors WHILE YOU DRIVE and catches the fault when it happens

• Tells you what it would check next, and why — spark, fuel, sensor, wiring

• Knows your car: recalls, technical service bulletins, and verified wheel-end torque specs

• Explains at your level, from first-time DIYer to working technician

NO ACCOUNT. NO EMAIL. EVER.

Download and start. Fixiom never asks who you are.

WORKS WITH

Most Bluetooth Low Energy OBD2 adapters (Veepeak, vLinker and similar). Every gas vehicle sold in the US since 1996 supports OBD2. Adapter guidance is built into the app.

WHAT FIXIOM WON'T PRETEND TO DO

No tool can fix your car by itself. Fixiom is honest about what it can see, tells you when a hands-on check or a shop visit is the right move, and never invents an answer it can't back up.

description:
Internal combustion engine

The free application "Internal combustion engine" is very friendly, it has a beautiful and simple interface. The best choice for a pocket dictionary that is always at hand. From which you can learn a lot of new and interesting things, for example, that:

Ecotec

Ecotec is a General Motors (GM) trademark that refers to a series of emissions technologies that were implemented throughout a range of GM engines. ECOTEC can refer to the following diesel and petrol engines produced by General Motors:Ecotec Family 0 - straight-four DOHC engines produced by Adam Opel AG and GM Powertrain US.

Ecotec Family 1 - straight-four SOHC/DOHC engines produced by Adam Opel AG, GM Korea, and GM do Brasil.

Ecotec Family II - straight-four SOHC/DOHC engines produced by Adam Opel AG, Holden, and GM do Brasil.

Ecotec L850 - straight-four all-aluminium DOHC engines produced by Adam Opel AG, GM Powertrain US, and Saab.

Ecotec V6 - a version of the Series II 3800 V6 engine, produced by the Holden Engine Company between 1995 and 2004.

CDTI Ecotec - common rail diesel engines for Opel/Vauxhall cars:

originally designed and produced by Fiat (MultiJet) and currently produced by Adam Opel AG;

produced by Isuzu.

VCDi Ecotec - common rail diesel engines for Chevrolet and Holden cars, produced by GM Korea.

DTI Ecotec - diesel engines for use in Opel/Vauxhall cars, produced by Isuzu

SIDI Ecotec - petrol Medium Gasoline Engine produced by Adam Opel AG

Ecotec3 is the name used on General Motors' Small Block Gen 5 Engines. All include direct injection, cylinder deactivation and continuously variable valve timing, either in V6 form of 4.3L or V8 form of either 5.3 or 6.2 liters.

General Motors 54° V6 engine

General Motors' Opel subsidiary in Europe designed a compact V6 engine with an unusual 54° vee angle. It was an iron block/aluminum head DOHC design with 4 valves per cylinder. All 54° engines were assembled at Ellesmere Port in England.

Sump

A sump is a low space that collects often undesirable liquids such as water or chemicals. A sump can also be an infiltration basin used to manage surface runoff water and recharge underground aquifers. Sump can also refer to an area in a cave where an underground flow of water exits the cave into the earth.

Features:

• The dictionary works offline - you do not need an internet connection. Access to articles (descriptions) offline, without an Internet connection (except for photographs);

• Very quick search for descriptions. Equipped with a quick dynamic search function - the dictionary will start searching for words during input;

• Unlimited number of notes (favorites);

• Bookmark - you can add descriptions to your favorites list by clicking on the asterisk icon;

• Manage bookmark lists - you can edit your bookmark lists or clear them;

• Search History;

• Voice search;

• Compatible with modern versions of Android devices;

• Very efficient, fast and good performance;

• An easy way to share with friends;

• The application is very easy to use, fast and with extensive content;

• Automatic free updates every time new terms are added;

• The directory "Internal combustion engine" is designed to occupy as little memory as possible.

Features Premium:

✓ no ads;

✓ photos, images of access offline;

✓ Clear browsing history.

You will see information about the MOT (APK), vehicle details, and, when available, the vehicle's emission class or Euro class. This allows you to more quickly assess whether a vehicle might be relevant to environmental zones or emission zones.

Additionally, you can save scanned vehicles in your garage. This allows you to easily build an overview of license plates you have checked previously.

What can you do with Scan Kenteken? • Scan license plates for free with the camera

• Enter license plate manually

• Perform a quick license plate check

• View make, model, and year of manufacture

• Check MOT expiry date

• Perform an MOT check for a vehicle

• View vehicle details

• View emission class or Euro class when available

• Useful for environmental zone or emission zone checks

• Save scanned vehicles in your garage

• Check fuel, weight, and basic information when available

• View insurance status when available

• Quickly check if the license plate matches the vehicle

Made for speed and simplicity

Scan Kenteken is designed for anyone who wants to look up a Dutch license plate quickly and for free. No complicated menus, no long forms, and no unnecessary distractions. You scan the license plate via the camera or type it in manually and immediately see the most important information. Useful for:

• Checking a used car

• Comparing cars

• Looking up a license plate

• Checking MOT expiry date

• Checking emission class

• Environmental zone license plate check

• Quickly viewing vehicle details

• Scanning a used car or stock

• Performing a car license plate check

• Finding previously scanned vehicles in your garage

• Inspection during purchase or viewing

Why Scan Kenteken?

• Free license plate scanner

• Scan license plate via camera

• Simple license plate check

• Clear MOT information

• Insight into emission class when available

• Useful for environmental zones and emission zones

• Garage for previously scanned vehicles

• Calm and clear interface

• Works with Dutch license plates

• Camera scan and manual entry

Scan Kenteken helps you quickly see which vehicle belongs to a license plate and what basic information is available. Ideal when you want quick clarity while on the road, when looking at a used car, or while comparing cars.

Please note

Scan Kenteken is not an official RDW app and is not affiliated with the RDW. The displayed vehicle data is intended as a quick indication. Rules for environmental zones and emission zones can vary by municipality. Always check important information with official sources before making a purchase decision or entering an environmental zone.

description:
RevDash is a live OBD-II dashboard for Android. Plug in a Bluetooth ELM327 adapter, connect once, and read engine data on a dark gauge grid that keeps polling in the background.

WHAT YOU NEED

• An ELM327-compatible Bluetooth Classic or BLE adapter

• A vehicle that speaks generic OBD-II (powertrain)

• Android 8.0 or later

FEATURES

• Live gauges: RPM, speed, coolant, throttle, load, battery voltage, and other Mode 01 PIDs your ECU reports

• VAG extras: oil temp, charge pressure (actual/spec), torque, lambda, timing, rail pressure, wastegate when your VW/Audi/SEAT/Skoda answers Mode 22

• Estimated gear: derived from RPM and speed (same idea as TrackAddict), works on manuals too

• Custom dash: add, remove, drag, and resize tiles; each vehicle profile keeps its own layout

• Connection that explains itself: one-tap reconnect, adapter bound to the vehicle profile, protocol hint, and a diagnostics screen that separates “Couldn’t reach adapter” from “Adapter OK, no ECU”

• Check-engine workflow: stored, pending, and permanent codes, freeze frame, generic SAE titles, clear only after you confirm

• Charts: live traces with 15s to 5m windows

• Trip CSV: GPS + OBD rows you save to a file you can open

• Backup: export and import vehicles and layouts as a zip

• Themes: Night, Day, OLED, Midnight; metric or imperial; keep-screen-on

WHAT REVDASH DOES NOT DO

• It does not read ABS, airbags, or body modules on generic OBD-II

• It does not write to the ECU or run actuator tests

• It is not a shop scan tool and not affiliated with any vehicle maker

description:
NO ADS!

CarNVH is a professional diagnostic tool designed for vehicle vibration and noise analysis. It helps identify imbalances, faulty components, and structural resonances under real-world driving conditions—without the need for expensive measurement equipment.

NEW – Statistical analysis of recorded data visualizes dominant frequency orders and helps identify the source of vibrations.*

Using your smartphone’s built-in sensors and a connected OBD2 adapter (ELM327**), CarNVH transforms your device into a portable automotive spectrum analyzer for vibration and noise diagnostics. Ideal for car enthusiasts, mechanics, technicians, and automotive engineers.

🔬 Real-Time FFT Analysis & Signal Processing

- FFT spectrum analyzer for vibration and acoustic signals

- A wide range of graphs for real-time acoustic data processing, including envelope spectrum, knock detection, spectrogram/waterfall diagram, and many more

- Adjustable axes with additional features such as autoscaling, local maxima, and logarithmic display

🚗 Automotive Order Analysis

CarNVH uses:

- The smartphone microphone for noise analysis

- The built-in accelerometer for vibration analysis

- Vehicle speed from GPS for analyzing wheel-related vibrations

- Engine speed via OBD2 (ELM327 chip**) for analyzing powertrain vibrations

This makes it possible to correlate vibration frequencies with rotating or reciprocating components such as the engine’s piston assembly, valve train, gearbox, drivetrain, and wheels. It is also suitable for detecting repetitive sources of vibration or noise, such as fuel injectors or PWM-controlled valves, including the EVAP valve.

- The custom gear-ratio function allows manual ratio input, making it easier to identify vibration sources within the drivetrain

💾 Recording & Offline Analysis

- Record vibration and acoustic measurements in various formats (.txt, .csv, .tsv, .jsonl, and .wav)

- Reload and analyze recorded data offline using the main vibration and acoustic graphs

- Perform statistical analysis using histograms, spectrograms, order trends, and other tools for clear visualization of the results

All data is processed locally on the device.

CarNVH provides relative diagnostic insights and is intended as a practical analysis tool rather than a certified measuring instrument.

*The analysis is based on the recorded data. Because the results depend on the smartphone’s position and the nature of the fault, the source of the vibration cannot be identified with 100% certainty.

**Standard low-cost OBD2 adapters based on the ELM327 chip are supported. Third-party adapters that use proprietary communication protocols, such as TOPDON or OBDLink, are not supported.

AMA MyPace is Alberta’s first true pay-as-you-go auto insurance, meaning you get to control your premium based on how many kilometres your car is driven. If your car is driven less than 9,000 km a year, see how much more AMA MyPace can save you compared to traditional car insurance.

To use the app, you’ll need to be on an AMA MyPace policy and install a dedicated on-board diagnostic (OBD) device in your vehicle. To check your eligibility and get started, call an AMA Insurance advisor at 1-800-615-5896. Learn more at AMAMyPace.ca.

AMA MyPace is a type of telematics or usage based insurance that calculates your premium based on the number of kilometres your vehicle is driven. It provides Albertans flexibility to choose insurance suited to their lifestyle. When your vehicle is driven less, your insurance should reflect that. AMA MyPace does just that.

The AMA MyPace App works with your unique AMA MyPace OBD device to track your kilometres , keeping you informed and in control (no user input required). DRIVE COACH by DrivOlution is a telematics tool for driving analysis of any motorized vehicle. It is part of the SafeDrive Journey training program developed by DrivOlution for a safer and more sustainable mobility. DRIVE COACH offers your organization the opportunity to improve the driving behavior of its whole fleet. The app helps you to improve your driving skills with in-app coaching tools. The app is very easy to install and to set up. No calibration is required. No cradle or other hardware is needed. DRIVE COACH only uses smartphone sensors to calculate indicators that reflect your driving behavior. The app uses very little power.

How does it work?

The app automatically detects motorized trips without any action on the part of the driver. It collects driving data and provides the driver with an analysis of each trip and statistics to monitor his progress. The analysis includes up to 4 scores:

A safety score that expresses the safety of the driving by analyzing the dynamic behavior of the vehicle on the road.

An eco-driving score which indicates the efficiency of the trip by measures the rate of acceleration, irregular speed and the rate of deceleration.

A distraction score that measures interactions with the smartphone while driving.

A speeding score that highlights the respect of the driver for speed limits. It changes according to the distance traveled above the speed limit.

After each trip, the driver automatically receives the scores and tips on how to do better next time. For each score, the driver can also see his progress in the ranking of his organization.

SMARTPHONES AND ROAD SAFETY

We believe that this technology is particularly effective in protecting employees in a simple and fun way, by making them aware of good practices when behind the wheel. The assessment of driving behavior is exhaustive, impartial and allows each driver to apprehend the risks he or she may take under real conditions.

Features

- automatic detection of trips (no dongle // no hardware)

- list of trips

- driving scores and weekly statistics

- cartographic visualization of driving events

- summary of driving performance according to contexts and road conditions (weather, week/weekend, day/night, trafic, etc.)

- configuration and selection of one or more vehicles

- driving challenges

- contextualized coaching

About DrivOlution

Does your fleet consist of trucks, passenger cars, vans or bicycles? DrivOlution has the expertise to guide your organization towards a better driving style and to embed these changes into the corporate culture. DrivOlution is a team of specialists with a heart for road safety, economical driving and sustainable mobility. We offer a total approach for sustainable improvement of driving behavior, fully tailored to your organization.

description:
Will the new wheels fit?

Enter the tire and wheel you run now and the ones you are considering. The app draws both to scale, one over the other, from the same hub mounting face — so you can see how much further the new rim pokes out, how much closer it sits to the strut, and how much taller the whole wheel becomes.

THE DRAWING

Both wheels are drawn in cross-section on a shared axis, with the hub mounting face as the reference line. Pinch to zoom in up to 6x: the rim opens out into a real flange-and-drop-centre profile, a ruler appears along the top, and every dimension gets its own callout — rim width, section width, offset, backspace, and the gap between the two rims inside and out.

SIXTEEN MEASUREMENTS

Old and new side by side, each row with the difference:

• Disk width, tire width, tire height

• Overall diameter and circumference

• Poke, inset, backspace

• Speed error, plus what your speedometer will read at two speeds you pick

• Ride height gain and arch gap loss

• Suspension clearance, fender clearance, scrub radius

VEHICLE CATALOG

Don't know your factory sizes? Choose a make, a year and a model, and the app lists the wheel sets the car was sold with — staggered sets included — along with its spec sheet: generation, body, engine, power, bolt pattern, PCD, stud holes, centre bore and tire pressures. Tap a set to drop it straight into the comparison.

UP TO SIX SETUPS

Line up six wheels at once and swipe between them. Every setup holds a front and a rear axle, so staggered fitments stay staggered instead of being averaged away.

BOTH NOTATIONS

ISO metric (205/55 R16) and LT high flotation (33x12.50 R15).

YOUR UNITS, YOUR LANGUAGE

Millimetres or inches, km/h or mph. English, Русский, Italiano, Deutsch, Français, Čeština, Español, עברית.

SHARE IT

One tap turns the drawing and the full comparison table into a single image — send it to a friend, a forum thread or your fitter.

No ads, no sign-up. The maths runs on your device; only the vehicle catalog needs a connection.

description:
A big technical encyclopedia "Internal combustion engine": gasoline engine, diesel engine, cylinder head, combustion chamber, dohc, spark plug, fuel pump, injection system, exhaust system.

An internal combustion engine is a type of heat engine in which the fuel mixture is burned inside the engine in a combustion chamber. Such an engine converts the energy of fuel combustion into mechanical work.

In spark ignition engines, such as petrol (gasoline) engines, the combustion chamber is usually located in the cylinder head. The engines are often designed such that the bottom of combustion chamber is roughly in line with the top of the engine block.

A crankshaft is a shaft driven by a crank mechanism, consisting of a series of cranks and crankpins to which the connecting rods of an engine are attached. It is a mechanical part able to perform a conversion between reciprocating motion and rotational motion.

The piston is the main component of pumps, compressors and reciprocating internal combustion engines, used to convert the energy of compressed gas into the energy of translational motion. The connecting rods and the crankshaft are used to further convert energy into torque. An opposed-piston engine is a piston engine in which each cylinder has a piston at both ends, and no cylinder head.

In internal combustion engines, the cylinder head is mounted on the cylinder block, locking the cylinders and forming closed combustion chambers. The joint between the head and the block is sealed with a block head gasket. Valves with springs, spark plugs, injectors are usually mounted in the head. Depending on the type of engine (stroke, ignition system, type of cooling, gas distribution system), the head arrangement can differ to a very large extent.

The carburetor is designed to prepare a combustible mixture by mixing liquid fuel with air and regulating the amount of its supply to the engine cylinders. The fuel injection system, in contrast to the carburetor system, supplies fuel by means of forced injection using nozzles into the intake manifold or into the cylinder.

A valvetrain or valve train is a mechanical system that controls the operation of the intake and exhaust valves in an internal combustion engine. The intake valves control the flow of air / fuel mixture (or air alone for direct-injected engines) into the combustion chamber, while the exhaust valves control the flow of spent exhaust gasses out of the combusion chamber.

An ignition system generates a spark or heats an electrode to a high temperature to ignite a fuel-air mixture in spark ignition internal combustion engines. The widest application for spark ignition internal combustion engines is in petrol (gasoline) road vehicles such as cars and motorcycles.

The fuel pump is an integral part of any fuel injection system that supplies fuel directly to the cylinder of a piston engine. The fuel pump is designed to create pressure in the fuel line, which must be much higher than the pressure in the engine cylinder.

The vehicle's exhaust system is designed to minimize the build-up of harmful gases inside the engine. The exhaust manifold is directly adjacent to the engine, receiving exhaust fumes from an explosion in the combustion chamber. The exhaust manifold is connected to a catalyst in which harmful substances are decomposed into less toxic substances and water.

Your privacy stays in your hands. Trips, routes, vehicles, settings and other app data are stored locally on your device. No account is required. description:
The inspection sticker says 10/2026, but who thinks about that in October? If you're more than two months overdue for your vehicle inspection, it becomes more expensive, and you risk a tiered fine; for longer overdue periods, you even get a penalty point (details in the official fine schedule linked below). AutoFrist, the car app for vehicle inspection and TÜV reminders, notifies you in time before it gets to that point.

ALL CAR DEADLINES IN ONE PLACE

• Vehicle Inspection (HU, colloquially TÜV): Enter the month and year from the sticker, and you're done. After passing the inspection, the app calculates the next due date starting from the month of the inspection, as backdating has not been possible since 2012.

• First-aid kit: The expiration date is printed in small type. If it's expired, it's considered a defect during the vehicle inspection. The app reminds you beforehand.

• Tire change: From October to Easter. Reminders around October 1st and April 15th, so you can get your tires done before the garage rush.

• Car insurance: Most contracts can only be canceled until November 30th. If you miss the deadline, you'll have to pay the old premium for another year.

DRIVER'S LICENSE EXCHANGE: YOUR PERSONAL DEADLINE

All driver's licenses issued before January 19, 2013, must be exchanged for the EU card-format driver's license in stages (§ 24a FeV with Annex 8e). For paper licenses, your deadline depends on your year of birth; for card-format licenses, it depends on the issue year. Hardly anyone keeps track of this schedule: cards issued between 1999 and 2001 are due by January 19, 2026. AutoFrist calculates your deadline and reminds you in good time.

REMINDERS THAT ARRIVE

You choose the lead time: 7, 14, or 30 days before each deadline. The reminder will still appear even if you don't open the app for months and will survive a phone restart.

MULTIPLE VEHICLES, CLEAR OVERVIEW

Car, motorcycle, camper van, trailer: Each vehicle has its own deadlines, sorted by urgency. The first due is listed at the top. Includes a fine warning if a vehicle inspection (HU) is overdue.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS

No registration, no cloud storage, no tracking, no ads. All data stays on your device.

FREE AND PRO

Manage one vehicle permanently for free, with all reminders and the driver's license calculator. For a second car, motorcycle, or trailer, Pro is available as a one-time purchase: unlimited vehicles and CSV export. No subscription.

For anyone who has ever shown up for their vehicle inspection with an expired sticker or had to look up their driver's license renewal date: This app remembers it for you.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

AutoFrist is a private service and not an app from any government agency. The app is not affiliated with or represents any government agency. All information provided is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice; the official legal texts (linked below and within the app) are the authoritative source.

AutoFrist is a private service and not an app from any government agency. OFFICIAL SOURCES

• Section 29 of the German Road Traffic Licensing Regulations (StVZO), Periodic Technical Inspection: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/stvzo_2012/__29.html

• Annex VIII of the StVZO, Inspection Intervals: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/stvzo_2012/anlage_viii.html

• Section 35h of the StVZO, First Aid Supplies: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/stvzo_2012/__35h.html

• Section 24a of the German Driving License Ordinance (FeV), Exchange of Old Driving Licenses: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/fev_2010/__24a.html

• Annex 8e of the FeV, Exchange Scheme: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/fev_2010/anlage_8e.html

• Ordinance on Fines for Traffic Offenses (BKatV): https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bkatv_2013/

Using "Car check. Anti-buy-in" you can check the following information on the car you are interested in:

🚩 Car mileage

Allows you to find the mileage that was recorded by the inspection operator. We are collecting our own mileage database. To do this, we use the technical inspection database and the advertisement database. Many cars already have results in the form of several runs. The database is constantly updated and checked. Checking this database is free.

🚩 Checking the registration history with the traffic police and public services

Obtaining basic information about the vehicle and the periods of its registration with the traffic police for various owners. Receiving data on vehicle disposal. Checking car history.

🚩 Check for participation in an accident

Obtaining information about traffic accidents involving a vehicle with the specified VIN identification number (VIN) that occurred since the beginning of 2015.

🚩 Checking whether you are wanted

Obtaining information about the federal search for a vehicle by law enforcement agencies through government services.auto.

🚩 Checking for restrictions

Obtaining information about the presence of restrictions on registration actions with the traffic police with a vehicle.

🚩 Search for car VIN and photos by state number

It will help you find the VIN code of a car, I only know its state registration plate. To search for photos, the service avto-nomer.ru is used.

This check will let you know if the seller has any debts that could complicate the purchase of the car.

🚩 Checking the MTPL policy

Allows you to find out whether the MTPL policy is active. Usually, resellers do not take out a policy, trying to save money.

Allows you to find out whether the car has undergone a technical inspection (technical inspection). Also, there is a possibility that an old car number will be found, by which you can additionally search for information about the car. It happens that you can even find photographs by number.

description:
Stop worrying about unfair damage charges when renting a car.

CarRentPal is your essential tool for documenting the true condition of a vehicle. Whether you are a fleet manager, a Turo host, or simply renting a car for a holiday, our app helps you create a professional, tamper-proof digital record of the vehicle's state before you drive away.

Paper forms get lost, and vague photos don't prove anything. CarRentPal allows you to generate a detailed Vehicle Condition Report in minutes, complete with timestamped photos, GPS location, and digital signatures.

🔥 KEY FEATURES THAT SET US APART:

👻 Ghost Mode (Compare Before & After) The biggest problem with inspections? Taking a photo of a scratch at the exact same angle when returning the car.

Our Solution: When you return the vehicle, CarRentPal overlays the original "Pick-up" photo on your camera screen (semi-transparently). You can align your shot perfectly to prove that a scratch hasn't grown or that a dent was already there.

📸 Smart Inspection Workflow Don't miss a spot. The app guides you through standard inspection zones:

Exterior (Front, Back, Sides)

Interior & Cockpit

Wheels & Rims

Fuel Level & Mileage (Odometer)

🔍 AI License Plate Scanner (OCR) Save time and avoid typos. Instead of typing the VIN or Registration Number manually, simply point your camera at the plate. Our built-in OCR Scanner instantly recognizes the text and fills in the vehicle details for you.

📄 Professional PDF Reports Turn your photos and notes into a signed legal document instantly.

Generates a clean, readable PDF Handover Protocol.

Includes exact Date, Time, and GPS Location of the inspection.

Ready to share via Email, WhatsApp, or Drive directly to the rental agency or customer.

💾 Secure Offline Database & Backup Inspecting a car in an underground garage with no signal? No problem. CarRentPal works 100% offline.

All data is stored locally on your device.

Create full backups (ZIP export) to secure your history or move data to another phone.

WHO IS THIS APP FOR? ✅ Car Rental Customers: Protect your security deposit. Have undeniable proof if a rental company tries to charge you for pre-existing damage. ✅ Turo, Getaround & SnappCar Hosts: Document the condition of your fleet before every trip to handle insurance claims faster. ✅ Fleet Managers: Keep a digital history of every handover in your company. ✅ Car Buyers/Sellers: Create a transparent report of the car's cosmetic condition during a sale.

Why trust CarRentPal? We focused on speed and evidence quality. With features like Ghost Mode and Biometric Security, you get a tool that is not just a checklist, but a professional witness in your pocket.

Download CarRentPal today and drive with peace of mind!
